verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a built-in 'Replit Design' visual design space/template system (docs-6, docs-15, docs-22, docs-32, docs-52) that lets users tweak designs and turn templates into functional sites, but there is no mention anywhere of importing an actual Figma file or existing external design asset into the builder. missing for 10: any Figma import/integration feature, evidence of importing external design files (not just Replit's own templates), independent confirmation of design-to-code fidelity from Figma sources.
